name: eventVolume
description: Event count over time for a project, optionally filtered to a single event name

query.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, count() AS events FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{timeframe.start}}') AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{timeframe.end}}') {{event ? "AND event = '" + event.split("'").join("''") + "'" : ''}} GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

ui.name: event
ui.label: Event name (optional)
ui.help: Filter to a specific event name, e.g. $pageview. Leave blank to count all events.
